dsql_query.sql: SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY revenue DESC
